name: Stormwind Armor Marker
label: Item
description: Stormwind Armor Marker lets those who aid the realm claim crafted gear from sanctioned artisans. Sara Timberlain accepts one at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
intro: Stormwind Armor Marker lets those who aid the realm claim crafted gear from sanctioned artisans. Sara Timberlain accepts one at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

p: Stormwind's commanders issue armor markers to those who serve the realm. Keeping law and order across Elwynn Forest stretches Stormwind's resources thin, so commanders sometimes use these official requisition slips instead of handing out standard gear at military outposts. A marker confirms the bearer's service and authorizes local craftsmen under contract to provide tailored armor.

At the Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain and other artisans work under commission from the Stormwind Army. The camp lies on Elwynn's eastern frontier, where they use local materials to make protective cloth and leather garments. Present a marker there to receive custom-fitted defense for guarding the surrounding woodlands.
